text_block_list.text: One lunch break before the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Compared to the other girls, my final stretch
really still has a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I need to raise my top speed a bit more.
With my current condition, I'll definitely be left behind in the Satsuki Sho...

They say the first race of the Classic campaign,
the Satsuki Sho, is won by the fastest Umamusume.
The speed to dash through 2,000 meters of turf at the heavily undulating Nakayama Racecourse. Early growth in time for the first race of the Classic campaign is what truly makes the difference.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It's not as accurate as yours,
Trainer, but I wanted to think through whatever I could on my own.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —And so, umm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to add a bit more lower-body weight training.
...What do you think?
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's work out a plan together!

text_block_list.text:
Along with her and her overflowing motivation,
the days of training hard for the
Satsuki Sho continued!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, do you mind if I do
a bit more voluntary training after this?
It's the same routine as yesterday, though—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Haaah--!!

When she suddenly snapped her head to look,
—Agnes Tachyon was standing there.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah!
Incredible, they're accelerating rapidly—!

Bearing the name of a hypothetical faster-than-light particle, her
running was so fast you wouldn't dare to blink.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...!
Fufu...! Hahaha!

As if trying to outrun the setting sun,
she steadily accelerated and dashed past—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...A "genius"...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "...I heard Tachyon-chan clocked a closing burst of 33.8 seconds in her debut race."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"In that year-end race against Pokke-chan the other day,
she achieved a complete victory by 2.5 lengths
against a top-tier field...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"And in last month's graded race,
despite the heavy track where it's hard to find a burst of speed,
she won by a commanding 5 lengths!"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable strength!
Agnes Tachyon can definitely take the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I only watched the video yesterday, but it gave me goosebumps...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Her speed, her acceleration—everything is on a completely different level.
She was simply born gifted.
Tachyon-chan, that is—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Just how far will Tachyon-chan go...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: W-W-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"That's no good, I just couldn't help myself...!
Even though Tachyon-chan is my rival."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, gotta fire myself up!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go run a lap real quick!
Tyaaaah!!

Standing before an obstacle that must be overcome,
the days of gritting one's teeth and training hard went on—

"And so it arrived:
the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Tachyon!
I am definitely gonna see Tachyon
win the Triple Crown this year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm rooting for Pokke, though.
That year-end battle against Tachyon was a great race, so I really want to see a rematch.
The crowd's expectations in the stands leaned heavily toward Agnes Tachyon and Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Everyone's reaction right now doesn't matter.
I just have to do what I can today...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Today—I'm gonna win! And not just today!
The Nippon Derby, the Kikuka Sho,
and everything after that—it's all gonna be mine!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: With my... "strength"...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu—hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You really are fascinating, Pokke!
Both your talent and your passion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's special.
Today, I've prepared a parting gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Burn this deeply into your eyes.
...Hahahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah...
Those two never change, do they?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I mean... you're not conscious of me at all, are you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: I'll show you how Dantsu really runs today!
Now I'll show you what Dantsu's running is all about!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'm here too.
I'm going to show them that... definitely...!"

Without retreating or sulking, I must do what needs to be done.
First, I want to show my strength with a victory in the Satsuki Sho!
